articles.summary: Bit Digital, Inc. (NASDAQ: BTBT), today announced that it will release its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, before the market opens on Thursday, August 13, 2026. Senior management will host a live webcast and conference call to discuss the results at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, August 13, 2026.
